title: Bound process-memory Multi-Site health history by Site cardinality

opportunity.rootCause: SiteHealthHistory bounded observations per Site but retained an unbounded dictionary of Site keys; repeated Site creation/deletion could grow process-memory fallback state indefinitely.

implementation: Added a configurable global maxSites bound with a safe default of 1024 and constructor validation.
Added recency tracking and least-recently-used eviction when a new Site would exceed the bound.
Touching a Site on Record and Read preserves recently active Site histories while retaining per-Site observation bounds and reason redaction.

tddRed.reason: The history implementation had no maxSites or recency/cardinality bound.

boundaries: Long-running process-memory allocation benchmark with thousands of live Sites
Live PostgreSQL fallback activation and concurrent multi-instance execution
CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification
